ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOFLEASE ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOFLEASE,dated asofthe14thdayofMay,2021(this "Assignment and Assumption"), between NAUTILUS REAL ESTATE, INC., a New York corporation, having an office at c/o Colonnade Management, Inc., 217 Broadway, Suite 700, New York, New York 10017 ("Assignor"), and NAUTILUS TUDOR LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an office at c/o Colonnade Management, Inc., 217 Broadway, Suite 700, New York. New York 10017 ("Assignee"). WITNESSETH: land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County, and State of New York, known as 2 (a/k/a 220) Tudor City Place, New York, NewYork 10017, and more particularly bounded and described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Premises"). NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the sum of Ten ($10.00) Dollars and other good and valuable consideration paid by Assignee to Assignor, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, Assignor hereby assigns, transfers, conveys, grants and sets over to Assignee all of Assignor's right, title and interest, as landlord, in and to the lease, as amended and assigned, set forth on Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (collectively, the "Lease"), and, if any,the guaranties and non-disturbance agreements (the Lease and any guaranties and non-disturbance agreements, collectively, the "Lease Documents") with regard to the Premises. TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the same unto Assignee, its successors and assigns, forever, from and after the date hereof, subject to the terms, covenants, conditions and provisions of the Lease Documents.

or implied, by or recourse against Assignor of any kind or nature whatsoever, except as expressly providedherein. Assignee hereby accepts the foregoing assignment, and assumes and agrees to perform and observe all of the terms, covenants, conditions and obligations contained in the Lease Documents on the landlord's part to be performed and observed arising on or after the date hereof, all with the full force and effect as if Assignee had signed the Lease, and accepted the delivery of or signed, as the case may be, any of the other LeaseDocuments originally as the landlord named therein. each of its officers, stockholders, members, partners, principals, directors, affiliates, subsidiaries, parents, agents, employees, and successors and assigns, from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, liabilities, actions, suits, proceedings, demands, assessments, adjustments, costs, expenses, charges and fees (including,without limitation,reasonable attorneys'fees, disbursements and expenses) arising or accruing under, or in connection with, directly or indirectly, any of the Lease Documents from and after thedatehereof. Assignor covenants and agrees to indemnify, defend, protect and hold harmless Assignee and each of its officers,stockholders,members,partners,principals, directors,affiliates,subsidiaries,parents, agents, employees, and successors and assigns, from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, liabilities, actions, suits, proceedings, demands, assessments, adjustments, costs, expenses, charges and fees (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees, disbursements and expenses) arising or accruing under,or in connection with,directly or indirectly,any of the Lease Documents prior to the date hereof.
